reviewedSummaries.purpose: Route committed vocal and physical causes through structured acoustic events, lawful listener receipts, and shared bounded presentation.
preconditions: A causal domain has committed the action or experience that produced the sound.
inputs: bounded intensity, reach, duration, and repetition key
outputs: committed audio with optional bounded caption and world-label presentation
invariants: The causal domain owns why the sound happened; presentation never creates the event.
Heard-unseen receipts do not reveal exact source identity or position.
Presentation suppression cannot erase lawful hearing or committed audio.
Consumed ephemeral sound presentation does not replay after save/load.
prohibitions: No animation- or caption-authored authoritative sound.
exceptions: Many lawful sounds remain audio-only when text is not salient or presentation capacity is unavailable.

Current surface-terrain transmission covers authenticated core alarms, player steps, dog body-contact receipts and existing keeper/introduction/weather-hold/departure/warning/guardian-call/cat-rain/fox-pursuit/player-reaction sources' independent human audience, including authenticated refused cat/fox hearing. Player reactions retain their exact committed causal locus, including phase ten. A warm admitted cat/fox sound retains coarse hearing when detailed cause becomes unavailable. Fox pending-save and refused-call retention, co-admitted core alarms, and cat admitted/refused pending restore authenticate exact same-T bounded durable custody without relaxing fresh admission or reopening retired save formats; admitted carriers suppress physical twins and only current detailed cause can ground the retained sound. Visible-source classification independently requires the applicable ACTIVE materialized source body, never raw sound custody; cat keeps its original retreat-step tolerance around the historical wet-track locus. Sparse-owner departure and an originally visible call later losing detail remain unproven; distant edge fixtures do not certify positive hearing or ordinary travel. Saved player speech receipts, unknown height/depth, aggregate support, off-frame geography and other unjoined consumers remain explicitly partial rather than inferred clear paths.

Current exhaustion, ordinary/serious footing and protection/loss/recovery cargo choices retain bounded accepted history separate from consumed sound. Cargo keeps at most three origins with existing locks and loss-resolution precedence; pickup uses its action frontier, traversal its actual step. Other meanings remain interval-local, and broader sparse-choice/hours annoyance gates remain open.

Architecture's Learned animal-call recognition section owns bounded player knowledge from a genuine committed seen-and-heard call. A later lawful caption may identify the learned animal kind without a hidden individual, cause or anchor; catalogs, uncommitted intent, rabbit contact and aggregate choruses do not teach species.

reviewedSummaries.purpose: Preserve current authoritative saves now while distinguishing explicitly retired pre-1.0 development formats from supported post-1.0 saves.
preconditions: Every save carries explicit schema and generator identity sufficient for fail-closed validation.
outputs: deterministic supported migration after the official stable 1.0 baseline
invariants: Current-schema state, identity, custody, knowledge, and cross-system consequences round-trip without duplication, reroll, or loss.
Official stable 1.0 permanently latches strict forward compatibility for supported player saves.
Migration failure cannot half-commit over the original stored record.
prohibitions: No best-effort partial legacy load or silent reset.
No prerelease or later development build may disable a latched 1.0 compatibility promise.
exceptions: Before official stable 1.0, an obsolete internal development schema may be explicitly retired when a safe migration is not worth its cost.
